ARABIC — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

3. When practising Reading Aloud: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud: Fluency.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud: Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud: Fluency.

6. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

7. When practising Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
